facts.text: Tim mentions that 'The Santa Clause' is a heartwarming movie that gets them feeling festive.

evidence.quote: We love 'The Santa Clause' too- it's so heartwarming and gets us all feeling festive!
'The Santa Clause' is a classic! It's so sweet and really captures the Christmas magic. It's just one of those movies that gets us all feeling festive.
